title: Right-derived unit normalization of a mixed exact derived mate
statement: Let C,D,E,V be abelian categories with derived categories, and assume K-injective resolutions exist in E and V. Let additive exact functors T:C→D, L′:D→V, L:C→E and O:E→V, additive right adjoints R:E→C and P:V→D with L⊣R and L′⊣P, and an isomorphism e:T⋙L′≅L⋙O be given. Write Q for homotopy localization, D for exact derivation, R(−) for right derivation, u_R and u_P for the right-derived unit transformations, and f_T and f_O for the exact-derived homotopy factor isomorphisms. Let β be a specified derived square equal to the exact-derived square induced by e. Let Γ:R(R)⋙D(T)→D(O)⋙R(P) be the mate of β. Let χ:R⋙T→O⋙P be the ordinary mate, and let χ̄_K include the canonical homotopy composition isomorphisms. For every K in the homotopy category of E, D(T)(u_R(K)) followed by Γ(QK) and R(P)(f_O(K)) equals f_T(RK) followed by Q(χ̄_K) and u_P(OK). Conventions: [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

proof.text: Replace the specified derived square β using its normalization equality, while all functors remain abstract. Expand the derived mate as the target adjunction unit, the exact derived square and the source counit. Move the source right-derived unit through these terms using naturality.
Apply the derived counit, square and unit factorization identities. Naturality of the target right-derived unit leaves the homotopy-category image of the ordinary mate.
On a complex representing the homotopy object, check degree by degree that the remaining composite is the ordinary mate. Homotopy quotient functoriality transports this equality.

theorem mixedDerivedMateUnit
    {C D E V : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E] [Category V]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [Abelian E] [Abelian V]
    [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D]
    [HasDerivedCategory E] [HasDerivedCategory V]
    [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions E] [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions V]
    (T : C ⥤ D) (L' : D ⥤ V) (L : C ⥤ E) (O : E ⥤ V)
    (R : E ⥤ C) (P : V ⥤ D)
    [T.Additive] [L'.Additive] [L.Additive] [O.Additive] [R.Additive] [P.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits T] [PreservesFiniteColimits T]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L'] [PreservesFiniteColimits L']
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L] [PreservesFiniteColimits L]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits O] [PreservesFiniteColimits O]
    (adj : L ⊣ R) (adj' : L' ⊣ P) (e : T ⋙ L' ≅ L ⋙ O)
    (β : T.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ L'.mapDerivedCategory ⟶
      L.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ O.mapDerivedCategory)
    (hβ : (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso e).hom = β)
    (K : HomotopyCategory E (.up ℤ)) :
    T.mapDerivedCategory.map (R.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K) ≫
        (mateEquiv adj.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction
          adj'.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction
          (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ β)).natTrans.app
          (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) ≫
        P.rightDerivedFunctor.map (O.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app K) =
      T.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app ((R.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map
          ((Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso (Iso.refl (R ⋙ T)) (.up ℤ)).hom.app K ≫
            ((mateEquiv adj adj' (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ e.hom)).natTrans.mapHomotopyCategory
              (.up ℤ)).app K ≫
            (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso (Iso.refl (O ⋙ P)) (.up ℤ)).inv.app K) ≫
        P.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((O.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K)
